item.title: Attorney General Ellison stops the use of predatory training repayment agreements for salon employees
item.description:
Publication Date: September 26, 2025

Settlements prohibit Deka Lash franchises in Minnesota from collecting alleged costs of on-the-job training, require employer to pay back wages deducted from final paychecks

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/09/26_DekaLash.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison reaches settlement with Shipt over allegations of misclassification
item.description:
Publication Date: September 26, 2025

Shipt agrees to $800,000 settlement payment and additional protections for workers, resolving AG’s 2022 lawsuit
